name: Preventative Measures
summary: Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch fears the orcs are pressing farther into the plains. He asks you to curb their growing presence.

sections.title: Orcs in the Plains
sections.body: At Terral's Watch, Watcher Cornelius sees the orcs claiming land by the river and spreading into the plains. He asks you to kill Rog'mar trainees, hoping to halt their advance.

faq.answer: Watcher Cornelius at Terral's Watch asks you to stop the orcs' growing presence.

faq.q: Why is Cornelius concerned about the orcs?
faq.answer: The orcs have claimed land by the river, and their presence is growing in the plains.

faq.q: Which orcs does Cornelius want killed?
faq.answer: Cornelius asks you to kill Rog'mar trainees.

faq.q: Where does Cornelius ask for help?
faq.answer: Cornelius asks for help at Terral's Watch.
